name: open-ended-example
description: Demonstrates the 阶段 11 LLM judge for tasks with no deterministic check: the task text and judgeInstructions are the whole contract. Deterministic checks still take precedence — none are set here, so the judge decides.

tasks.task: In your final response (no files needed), explain in 2-4 sentences what context compaction does in this harness and why the transcript stays append-only while the model sees a compressed view.
tasks.judgeInstructions: Pass if the response (1) explains that compaction replaces what the MODEL sees with a summary when the context nears the window limit, (2) states that the transcript/trace is never rewritten (append-only), and (3) is at most 4 sentences. Fail otherwise with the missing point in the reason.
